title: audit detail session.context_restored
description: detail of audit rows with action session.context_restored: the runner restored the task's context checkpoint into this session (ADR-059 section 7): the checkpoint, what came back of the workspace (partial and omitted are stored on the session as context_reason workspace_partial/workspace_omitted) and whether the checkpoint was stale (the final checkpoint of the previous session did not arrive in time, the newest one available was used). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
